note: THE GRATUS GROWTH BOOK. Five phases every planted emoji passes through, by days of care (a day counts once, when you write about it). The evolution arcs live in evolutions.json; the recipes in recipes.json. People add their own emojis and recipes in the app; those stay on the device.

phases.name: Planted
phases.meaning: You wrote it down. A moment of gratitude has a place now.

phases.name: Nurtured
phases.meaning: You came back to it. Attention is the water.

phases.name: Deepened
phases.meaning: Five days of care. It has roots you can feel.

phases.name: Bloomed
phases.meaning: Nine days. It opens, and other people can see it.

phases.name: Ready to Give
phases.meaning: Thirteen days of gratitude. It can leave your garden as a gift and keep growing in someone else's.
